movie.title: The Spin
movie.overview: A struggling record store owner travels down south to Cork with his best friend in a bid to save his shop from closure.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Facing the imminent loss of his music shop, a struggling record store owner embarks on a road trip to Cork with his best friend to secure a life-saving collection.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In a desperate attempt to save his failing record shop from permanent closure, a passionate owner convinces his best friend to join him on a high-stakes road trip down south to Cork. Along the journey, the duo navigates unexpected comedic detours, eccentric music lovers, and personal frictions that test their bond. Together, they must track down a legendary music find before time runs out. Ultimately, their southern expedition becomes less about the vinyl and more about discovering what truly holds their lives together.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Deeply buried under debt and threatened by the looming closure of his beloved independent record store, a dedicated owner reaches a breaking point. Driven by desperation, he learns of a rare and valuable vinyl collection located down south in Cork that could single-handedly resolve his financial crisis. Unable to make the journey alone, he persuades his loyal best friend to come along for the ride, setting off a chaotic road trip across Ireland. As the pair travel through scenic country routes and quirky local towns, they encounter a series of absurd obstacles, misadventures, and colorful local personalities. The financial pressure of the trip quickly brings long-simmering tensions between the two friends to the surface, forcing them to confront their personal failures and unfulfilled ambitions. Between navigating mechanical mishaps and chasing down elusive leads, their shared passion for music serves as their ultimate anchor. As the deadline to save the store approaches, the duo must work together to locate the prized record stash and pull off a last-minute miracle. The journey ultimately forces them to evaluate what they are truly fighting for, transforming a simple rescue mission into a deeply personal reflection on friendship, resilience, and identity.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: The Spin is a warm, character-driven comedy-drama that follows a desperate record store owner who embarks on a pivotal road trip to Cork alongside his best friend to save his struggling shop. Blending rich humor with soulful musical appreciation, the film explores the precarious state of independent vinyl culture through the lens of a deep, tested friendship. As the duo travels south, their external quest for a rare financial lifeline transforms into an internal exploration of ambition, loyalty, and nostalgia. Set against vibrant regional backdrops, the story captures the heart of small-town connections and the enduring power of music to bring people together.

story_structure.climax: The narrative reaches its peak when the friends face a critical, high-stakes moment in Cork where their entire plan—and the future of the store—hangs in the balance.
story_structure.conflict: The central struggle lies between the ticking clock to save the shop and the unexpected personal, financial, and logistical hurdles the pair encounter along the journey.
story_structure.resolution: The fallout of their journey settles, revealing the fate of the record store and bringing a new perspective to their friendship and future directions.
story_structure.introduction: Facing imminent closure of his beloved independent record store, a struggling owner and his best friend embark on a road trip down south to Cork to chase a promising lead that could save the business.
story_structure.risingAction: As the trip unfolds, tension builds through a series of misadventures, deepening financial pressure, and tests to the duo's friendship as they navigate unfamiliar territory.
